newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINN FARMA MAY REVISE PROFIT IN H1.
newsitem.headline: TALLINN FARMA MAY REVISE PROFIT IN H1.

text.p: Estonian drug company Tallinna Farmaatsiatehas may revise its profit estimate after its half-year results, chairman Priit Kivi said on Monday.
"Based on first quarter results, we do not rule out the possibility to make corrections to our profit estimate," Kivi told the company's shareholder meeting.
The earlier profit estimate of 38.5 million kroons was made conservatively, Kivi added.
Farmaatsiatehas' first quarter net profit was 11.19 million kroons. The company had a net profit of 27 million kroons last year on turnover of 160 million kroons.
